selected_evidence.summary: Effective blacklist/install-deny rules were present; direct modprobe returned failure and usb_storage remained unloaded.
The initramfs was rebuilt, and after reboot the policy remained present and effective; usb_storage was absent before and after a rejected direct load attempt.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 92ec88af-041e-4dc3-b2b9-800263b2b2cb; reboot was acknowledged; post-reboot boot ID changed to fbce90b0-8639-40f9-ad35-22e34a010df4; system state returned to running with a writable root filesystem and the usb-storage restriction intact.
